rules.sentence: Consider CT imaging for meningioma (if not already performed) to assess bone involvement if this is suspected.
Base management of meningioma after surgery, or if surgery is not possible or the person declines surgery, on the extent of any surgery and grade of meningioma, as described in table 4.

Before a decision is made on radiotherapy for meningioma, take into account: comorbidities life expectancy neurological function oedema performance status rate of tumour progression size and location of tumour surgical and radiotherapy morbidity the person's preferences (see table 5 for factors to discuss with them) treatments used before.
